_comment: NOTHING HERE IS COMMITTED TO THIS REPOSITORY AND NOTHING HERE IS
REDISTRIBUTED. Each entry is a URL plus the sha256 of the bytes that URL
served when the entry was written; scripts/gauntlet.py fetches into a
gitignored cache, verifies the digest, measures, and throws the bytes away.
That is a deliberate licence decision, not an accident of convenience. The
provenance below was read out of each file's own ISO-10303-21 HEADER
section -- objective evidence, not a guess about the hosting repo -- and it
says plainly that the two largest parts are a manufacturer's CAD download
and a named individual's GrabCAD upload. Neither may be redistributed by an
MIT project. Measuring a file is not redistributing it; committing one is.
The hosting repository (tpaviot/pythonocc-demos) ships NO LICENSE file, so
its contents are all-rights-reserved by default. Do not add a fixture here
on the assumption that a permissive repo licence covers its data files --
read the STEP header and record what it actually says.

fixtures.name: as1-oc-214
fixtures.what: AS1 aerospace test assembly -- the canonical STEP conformance part (plate, rod, brackets, bolts, nuts) as re-exported by Open CASCADE.
fixtures.licence: Not declared. Derived from the long-circulated AS1 STEP conformance assembly; the hosting repo states no licence.
